2607.26654.title: Constitutional Midtraining: Content Presence Drives Alignment Gains
2607.26654.paper_summary: Post-training alignment is often shallow, eroding under fine-tuning. Whether midtraining interventions, cleanly isolated from post-training, can produce durable alignment remains untested. We test this via constitutional midtraining: inserting principled, values-based content into midtraining against a replay-only control at 120B scale. Our 394M-token constitutional corpus, built from Anthropic's Constitution, uses a 2x2 factorial design (curriculum ordering x deliberative reasoning) to produce four constitutionally midtrained conditions plus a control, evaluated on self-generated and established benchmarks including alignment under pressure, value conflict resolution, blackmail, and emergent misalignment across three stages: post-midtraining, post-SFT, and post-benign fine-tuning. Constitutionally midtrained models outperform the control on alignment generalization and durability, notably on blackmail: SFT instills a blackmail propensity in all models, but constitutional midtraining blunts it, with the advantage surviving benign fine-tuning (-17.5pp). This durability does not extend to settings requiring active resistance to in-context pressure or conflict, where the advantage attenuates after SFT. The presence of constitutional content at midtraining also matters more than its structure, and constitutional midtraining incurs no cost, on average, on the capabilities we test (MMLU, ARC-Easy, piqa, GSM8K) at any stage. A modest amount of constitutional content at midtraining could therefore yield broad, persistent alignment gains, offering a cheap, complementary addition to SFT-centered pipelines. Code, data, and models are available.
2607.26654.paper_summary_zh: 後訓練的對齊通常較為淺薄，並在微調過程中逐漸減弱。中訓練的介入是否能夠在與後訓練清晰隔離的情況下產生持久的對齊仍未經測試。我們通過憲法中訓練來測試這一點：在120B規模的回放控制下，將原則性、基於價值的內容插入中訓練。我們的394M標記憲法語料庫，基於Anthropic的憲法，使用2x2因子設計（課程排序 x 深思熟慮的推理）來產生四種憲法中訓練條件以及一個控制組，並在自我生成和既定基準上進行評估，包括在壓力下的對齊、價值衝突解決、勒索以及在三個階段下的出現性錯位：中訓練後、SFT後和良性微調後。憲法中訓練的模型在對齊的泛化和持久性上超越了控制組，特別是在勒索方面：SFT在所有模型中灌輸了勒索傾向，但憲法中訓練削弱了這一傾向，並且這一優勢在良性微調後仍然存在（-17.5pp）。這種持久性並不延伸到需要主動抵抗上下文壓力或衝突的情境，在這些情境中，優勢在SFT後減弱。中訓練時憲法內容的存在比其結構更為重要，並且憲法中訓練在我們測試的能力（MMLU、ARC-Easy、piqa、GSM8K）上平均不會產生任何成本。中訓練時適量的憲法內容因此可能帶來廣泛而持久的對齊增益，為以SFT為中心的管道提供了一種廉價的互補補充。代碼、數據和模型均可獲得。
